preface.p: Great Barrier Reef Marine Park (Environmental Management Charge—General) Act 1993
This compilation was prepared on 2 December 2008 taking into account amendments up to Act No. 125 of 2008
The text of any of those amendments not in force on that date is appended in the Notes section
The operation of amendments that have been incorporated may be affected by application provisions that are set out in the Notes section
Prepared by the Office of Legislative Drafting and Publishing, Attorney-General’s Department, Canberra
An Act to impose a charge on the grant or transfer of certain permissions under the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Regulations, so far as that charge is neither a duty of customs nor a duty of excise

content.p: This Act may be cited as the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park (Environmental Management Charge—General) Act 1993.
This Act commences, or is taken to have commenced, as the case requires, on the commencement of Part VA of the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Act 1975.

section.heading: Application of the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Act 1975

content.p: Sections 4 and 5 of the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Act 1975 apply in relation to this Act in a corresponding way to the way in which they apply in relation to that Act.
(1) Charge payable in accordance with section 39B of the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Act 1975 is imposed.
This section imposes charge only so far as that charge is neither a duty of customs nor a duty of excise within the meaning of section 55 of the Constitution.
